title: feat(mcp,runtime)!: MCP names package skills, agents and actions by their AI face; run_action takes a namespace
body:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01ADHkmQo3yxJ3Pyjz3JbPEK

Fixes #31692

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：MCP 上软件包的 skill、agent、action 改用 ADR-0150 的 AI 名称（如 `crm-qualify_lead`）列出；`run_action` 可带 `namespace` 精确指定是哪个包的动作，`list_actions` 每行带 `namespace` 和 `face`。
- 为什么改：两个包声明同名动作或技能时，过去 MCP 悄悄挑第一个执行，可能跑错包的代码；现在要么按命名空间精确执行，要么明确拒绝并列出两个包。
- 风险与回滚：属收窄。包内技能的提示名从 `NAME` 变为 `NS-NAME`（单一持有者仍可用旧名获取）；同名双持有者的裸名调用改为 409 拒绝。一方实测：技能 0、智能体 0、双持有动作名 0。回滚即还原此 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` 的 `resolveActionByName` 与 `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts` 的 `lookupSkillPrompt`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/mcp-action-namespace.test.ts`，看双持有者拒绝、按 namespace 执行和单持有者对照三类用例。
- 需要你做的：无；席位与史诗席位按三条红线审阅后由席位落地。

## What changes

ADR-0150 child G2: the MCP surface addresses a package's skill, agent and action by (namespace, name) and names each by its AI face, derived by `deriveAiFaceName` (`@objectstack/spec/ai`), never re-spelled.

- **Skill prompts** (stdio and HTTP): `prompts/list` serves each skill under its face (`NS-NAME` for a package skill, the bare name for an environment skill). `prompts/get` takes the face, and the bare `NAME` while one package holds it; a bare name two packages hold is refused (`-32602`, data `{ code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT', status: 409, candidates: [both faces] }`) by R's rule (`resolvePackageScopedHolders`, caller with no package). `listSkillPrompts` keeps every holder instead of dropping all but the first.
- **Agents** (stdio): `agent_prompt` stays one prompt; `agentName` takes the agent's face (read by its package through the protocol's `getMetaItem({ packageId })`, E8) or the bare name (E8's environment-wide read, 409 on two holders). The argument's description names faces.
- **Actions** (HTTP `list_actions` / `run_action`): each row carries `namespace` (the holding package's manifest namespace) and `face` (`NS-NAME`, or `OBJECT-ACTION` for an object-bound action). `run_action` takes an optional `namespace`, the exact qualifier (D5): `resolveActionByName` maps it through `registry.getNamespaceOwners`, only those packages' declarations answer, and that package's handler runs (`executeRegisteredAction`'s `packageId`, E2). An unknown namespace is refused by name (404). Without `namespace`, an object-less name two packages hold is refused 409 naming both (`PackageScopedNameRefusedError`) instead of running the first.
- **Duplicate faces** (Q3 rider): a face two items derive is never served as one of them. `list_actions` names it once under `refusedFaces` and leaves it off both rows (both rows stay, each addressable by `namespace`); a prompt face two skills or two agents derive is registered once and answers a refusal naming both, and boot warns naming both.

Files: `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts`, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`, `packages/mcp/src/plugin.ts` (the stdio host's namespace lookup), `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` (`resolveActionByName`, `collectActionDeclarations`, `invokeBusinessAction` and its `dispatchAdmittedBusinessAction` call), `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `.changeset/31692-mcp-ai-faces-namespace.md`.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/mcp-action-namespace.test.ts` (new, over `HttpDispatcher.buildMcpBridge`): two packages' object-less `send_digest` — list shows both with namespace and face; no namespace refuses 409 naming both packages and runs nothing; `namespace: 'hr'` runs com.hr.pkg's handler; unknown namespace 404 naming it; a namespace that holds no such action 404; CONTROL single holder runs unqualified as today; an object-bound face is `OBJECT-ACTION`.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-tools.test.ts`: namespace/face pass-through, a duplicate face refused once with both rows kept, `namespace` forwarded only when given (CONTROL: no key when omitted), a bridge 409 reaches the caller coded.
- `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.test.ts`: 7 new face tests (list by face, get by face, bare get while one holder, bare two-holder refusal with candidates, duplicate face, environment skill keeps its bare name).
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.agent-prompt-advertised.test.ts`: 5 new stdio tests (face list order, agent faces in the description, a face get reads by packageId, bare two-holder refusals, CONTROL single holder, a duplicate face registered once with two warnings).
- Forced test edit: `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.test.ts`, the `projectSkillPrompt` expectation gains `face: 'case_management'` (the projected prompt now carries its face).
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each red then restored to the HEAD blob): the runtime two-holder refusal (1 red), the runtime namespace arm (3 red), the bare two-holder skill refusal (2 red), the `run_action` namespace forward (1 red), the `list_actions` duplicate-face threshold (1 red), the duplicate agent face refusal (1 red).

## Acceptance notes

ADR-0150 readings:

- **(a)** The phase-1 one-holder tests stay green: the dogfood battery (`bare-name-one-holder*.dogfood`) runs on this head; see Verification.
- **(b)** Bare-name behaviour is unchanged for every name with one holder: pinned by the CONTROL tests on both transports and on `run_action`. The declared narrowing for two-holder names stands in its place (below).
- **(c)** No migration: nothing at rest changes shape.
- **(d)** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`; `Metadata-protocol: none`; the changeset carries the BREAKING banner (FROM → TO) and an `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition.

Declared narrowing (seat ruling, claim amendment 6740941608): a package-held skill prompt is listed as `NS-NAME`, not `NAME`; a bare skill, agent or object-less action name two packages hold is refused instead of picked. Measured first-party census: skills 0, agents 0, object-less action names held by two first-party packages 0 (36 `defineAction` names, each held by one package).

Deviations from the card's text, each bounded by the seat ruling:

- The qualified action resolution applies R's rule (`resolvePackageScopedHolders`) over the MCP declaration rows rather than calling `resolveActionByPackage` itself: that reader walks registry `action` items with closure semantics and does not see object-embedded actions, while D5's namespace is the exact qualifier.
- `dispatchAdmittedBusinessAction` gains the resolved `packageId` so the named package's handler runs; it sits beside `invokeBusinessAction`, not in the three named functions.
- An object-bound pair two packages bind to ONE object keeps today's first answer; its refusal is the action family's own card (#31697).
- The HTTP transport has no boot hook, so a duplicate skill face warns on the stdio host only; HTTP serves the refusal at list and get.
- `resolveRouteActionDeclaration` and `domains/actions.ts` are untouched (G1).

Two needed the tree first: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs its pinned fixture commit in this shallow clone (fetched, then green), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs every package built (rerun after the dogfood build, green).
